title: Power and politics
note: Greek kratos, power or rule, ends many words for who holds power: autocracy (one ruler), plutocracy (the rich), kleptocracy (thieves). Oligarchy instead uses arkhein, to rule: government by a few. Gerrymander blends Governor Elbridge Gerry's name with salamander, after a district map that looked like one in 1812.

items.a: dominance of one group or state over others
d: rule by a small group of the rich
items.ex: For a century, the empire's naval hegemony went unchallenged.

items.a: a ruler with unlimited personal power
d: a secret adviser behind a ruler
items.ex: The autocrat rewrote the constitution to rule for life.

items.a: a ruler who uses absolute power cruelly
